rejected_bracket.reason: The stronger 0.22 roughness, 0.30 sky fallback, and 0.090/0.115/0.140 ripple endpoint exposed camera-radial normal streaks in the TroubleMaker and Salmon Falls foregrounds.
rejected_bracket.decision: Retain the softer midpoint while preserving the corrected body colour, volume coefficients, and sky response.

map_regeneration.mesh_policy: hash-validated existing detailed terrain, water, and far-field meshes reused

retained_improvements: The fixed captures now preserve visible blue-sky reflection and gray-green body colour instead of collapsing broad water into a dark planar card.
Bounded metre-scale colour and normal variation makes the current legible without inventing foam or modifying solver-authored hydraulics.
The softened midpoint avoids the first bracket's strongest camera-radial foreground streaks.
open_visual_findings: The free surface remains a non-overturning heightfield and cannot reproduce real crest folding, plunging jets, boils, or entrained-air volume.
The repeated normal field remains analytical at hero distance and is not a substitute for rapid-scale geometric turbulence.
Foam, spray, terrain, shoreline, canopy volume, rocks, raft, characters, equipment, and motion remain below the requested photoreal target.
No named guide or art reviewer has approved the water scale, colour, motion, or rapid fidelity.
decision: Retain v133 as a bounded South Fork presentation improvement and keep every photoreal, release-art, and external-review gate fail-closed.
